chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, was asked about a funeral for which fire is taken along with it, and he said:
"Indeed, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, was taken out by night, and lamps were with her."

key_terms.ابْنَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the daughter of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْجَنَازَةِ: the funeral or bier being taken for burial
key_terms.بِالنَّارِ: with fire, meaning a torch, flame, or source of light accompanying the procession

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to carry lamps or fire with a funeral procession at night?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the practice of carrying fire or lamps with a funeral procession. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام cites the nighttime funeral of the daughter of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, indicating precedent for accompanying a جنازة with lamps at night.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.463 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about a funeral procession in which fire (torches or lamps) is carried.
Imam (as) replied: "The daughter of the Messenger of Allah (sw) was taken out at night, and lamps accompanied her."
